from.place: Proof paragraph 1: faithful flatness of each colimit stage implies nonvanishing after quotient by every maximal ideal of the base ring.

title: Faithfully flat maps have nonzero maximal-ideal fibres
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. Then for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset R$, the quotient $S/\mathfrak mS$ is nonzero (equivalently, $S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak m)\neq0$).
